notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.2/b01
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

We have made a few changes.

New features

 New module: RTG

Produces and stores electricity.
Uses the new resource ‘Radioactive Isotopes’ for operation.

 New resource: Radioactive isotopes
 
Required for the operation of the RTG.

 Manual relocation of residents
 
Residents can now be moved manually between living quarters.

 Side Quests
 
Smaller quests appear from time to time.
Note: There are currently only a few, but we are working on adding more.



Fixes

 Frame rate issues
 
Fixed an issue where the framerate would sometimes drop significantly.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.2/a06
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

We have made a few changes.

New features

 Quality settings and the window mode in the settings in the main menu
 °Fahrenheit can be set
 the repeating blinking of the selected station part can be switched off
 Filter for residents in various menus


Changes

 residents now need a certain amount of time to get to their workstation

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.2/a05
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

     Resource Views: Fixed issues with pipe’s resource specificity on special occasions.
     Graphical Glitches: Corrected earth clouds appearing in front of the moon.
     Turret Building Rotation
     Fixed issue where deconstruction of stations parts could get stuck when there were modules inside.


Changes

 Pioneer Model optimisations: Reduced disk storage usage, updated appearance.
 You can now cancel research tasks.
 Cost Dependency: Construction costs for pipe tracks and cables are now lengthdependent.
 Increased max length for pipe, heat pipe and cable segments.
 Cable connector can now support up to 5 cables at batteries and solar arrays.
 Maintenance Module: Efficiency independent of station parts integrity, minimum of 20% efficiency when unpowered.
 Prestige System:
 Renamed Reputation to Prestige.
 Removed Reputation Points.
 Licensing now requires initial credits and a recurring license fee per item used, payable daily.
 If the Prestige towards a company falls below the initial Prestige cost of a station part or module, it is not constructible as long as this is the case.
 Marketplace Renamed to Market.
 Resident Satisfaction: Moved from the bottom menu to the resident tooltip.
 Navigation and Camera Handling:
 Camera no longer moves automatically when selecting a station part, can be reenabled in settings.
 Camera is always in orbit mode, switchable to free mode by holding the shift key.
 Added 'H' and 'G' keys for home view.
 You can’t use the overview it there is no running scanner.
 Free mode is switched of when zooming out into overview.
 Wages: Now paid on a daily basis.
 Credit Balance: Interest accrues daily if balance falls below zero. Game lost when credits drop below -100k or all residents leave.
 Processes: Water cleaning, Algae growing an Making Food from Algae now need less power.
 Living quarter now shows if it is heating.
 When building a station part or a module, the stored and reserved* resources are shown. (* by other construction tasks)


New features

 Overhauled Tutorial: A completely revamped tutorial to enhance beginner experience,
    including six new scenarios in various locations for new challenges.
 New Quest Menu: Featuring a streamlined task display.
 New Station Parts:

     Heat Decoupler
     Various Braces: Medium Long Brace, Long Brace, L-Brace, T-Brace, X-Brace, TXBrace
     L-Type Station Part

 New mineable resource: Space Debris, mineable similarly to ore but found on drifting scrap,
not asteroids.


Various

     Warning in Settings: If not all keys are assigned.
     Added company filter in Prestige Menu.
     Changed station part selection shader.
     Removed top menu quest button.
     Saving/Loading optimisations and fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d16
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

We have made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

 A bug that caused the game to get stuck after loading a savegame has been fixed.


New features

 The station part with the built-in module "Radial Scanner" has been added. New objects can be discovered and further investigated with this station part.


Changes

 The tutorial has been adapted to the new station part.
 Scanning for new objects is no longer done manually in the zoomed out map but with the help of the radial scanner.
 The icons for asteroids, space debris and the station have been revised.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d15
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

we have fixed a few bugs.

Fixed bugs

 Fixed a bug that caused asteroids and space debris to be loaded outside the playable area.
 Fixed a bug that caused ships to sometimes get stuck after loading a savegame.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d14
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

a new patch with some changes is here!

Fixed bugs

 a UI bug in the station part menu has been fixed
 a bug has been fixed that caused the residents to keep their job when deconstructing modules


New features

 research has been given its own menu

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d13b
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

we have fixed a few bugs that were found by the player PanzerKadaver.
Thanks for that!

Fixed bugs

 you could no longer interact with the bottom menu
 the keybindings in the settings were messed up (loading a language was faulty)
 if you saved after a station part was completely deconstructed and removed, the game crashed
 the game crashed when trying to play in orbit around the moon
 a bug in the loading cycle of asteroids and space debris has been removed

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d13
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

 a bug in the drop-down menu has been fixed
 a bug that in some cases causes the game to crash on loading a new game has been fixed


New features

 loading a new game or a save game has now a little progress text

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d12
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

 a bug in the heat calculation has been fixed
 an error when deconstructing station parts has been fixed
 if you throw away the resources when deconstructing station parts, the deconstruction of the part is completed beforehand


Changes

 the heat calculation has been rebalanced


New features

 Modules can automatically process research tasks as soon as they are accepted. This function can be switched on and off. If the function is switched on, research tasks are prioritized and the previously selected process is continued after completion.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d11
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

 a bug that occurred when assigning pilots was fixed
 a bug that caused undocking ships to do nothing after loading savegames has also been fixed.


Changes

 the heat calculation was balanced again

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d10
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

 two errors that occurred during loading are fixed


Changes

 the heat calculation has been balanced
 the research tasks have become longer on average
 working on research tasks is now rewarded with each completed work cycle (in addition to the completion reward)
 when you start a new station on Venus or Mercury, the Pioneer gets 2 resp. 3 radiators to get rid of the heat


New features

 the resource flow overviews now show how much is flowing through where and what percentage that is of the maximum flow

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d09
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

 a new game starts paused
 the batteries do not show negative remaining capacities anymore
 in build mode the selected station part can be changed


Changes

 the living quarters got a bigger heater 
 a "credits" menu was introduced and the splash screen was shortened by one logo
 the assistance system has been kicked out
 the languages are now read in via a CSV file (is now easier to edit)
 the water for the inhabitants is now mixed directly into the food 
 some UI performance tweeks (with many station inhabitants the UI could pull a lot of processing power under some circumstances)
 the temperature behavior of the station parts has been reworked


New features

 new station inhabitants are now automatically assigned to workstations, priorities can be assigned to the workstations, but manual assignment is also still possible
 the camera can be locked in orbit or free mode
 the flowing resources like water or carbon dioxide got overviews, so that one gets an impression where what flows along

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d04
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

 An error that occurred when deconstructing station parts was fixed.
 A bug that occurred when filtering research tasks has been fixed.
 An error occurred when deconstructing turrets with connected power lines was fixed.
 A bug that could cause the game to crash when building station parts and auto-save became active at the same time has been removed.


Changes

 The algorithm that calculates the flow of fluid resources through the station has been optimized.
 When connecting fluid stores with cables or pipes, a different algorithm now takes effect when calculating flows, so the distance between stores no longer matters and it should flow faster.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d04
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes.

New features

 The top menu now also shows the number of residents.
 When selecting research tasks, two filters will now help you. We have also split the menu into two menus.
 In the resource detail menu you can now see which module currently consumes or produces how much of the selected resource.


Fixed bugs

 Errors could creep in when saving some game situations, causing crashes when reloading, saving and reloading. The save bug has been fixed, but some game saves may still contain the bug and continue to cause problems.


Changes

 The news sounds have been made louder.
 After completing a research task, the module resumes the process done before it.
 New station parts are built only when they are adjacent to a finished station part. But the resources are still transported to the construction site before.
 The prices at the marketplace have been revised. It should no longer happen that you buy for little and sell the same for a lot of money again.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d03
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes.

Additions

 If life support fails within 6 game hours, a warning will be given what is going wrong.


Fixed bugs

 The marketplace module did not work properly or at all.
 Sometimes the construction drones forgot their transport orders.
 Consumed power was re-initiated at the end of a production process, now it is not.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d02
notes.notes:
Moin,

we've made a few changes.

Additions

 There are resource icons now within the text.
 The tutorial had a small review and comes now with videos.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/d01
notes.notes:
Moin, 

we have made a few changes and introduced something new.

New Features

 In the settings, all functions can now be freely assigned to the keyboard as desired.
 Status icons have been added to the module icons in the station part management menu.
They indicate that workstations are not occupied or only partially occupied, if there are problems with the resource supply or if no production process is selected at all.
 The slowest speed can be switched with the space bar and the game speed can be adjusted with + and -. This keyboard layout can also be changed.
 The maximum efficiency with which a module should produce can be set. (This can be very useful in the event of power shortage)


Bug Fixes

 Fixed that the camera continues to move when the quest menu opens and the camera was moved.
 Fixed that the game sometimes partially freezes when building power lines.
 The calculation of resource flows has been reworked so that unnatural bottlenecks should no longer occur.


Changes

 The selection of processes is now done by a dropdown menu.
 In the pioneer station part, the battery is now visible.
 When the quest menu is closed, the game speed is set to normal.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/c02
notes.notes:
Moin,

we've made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

 Deleting saved games is possible again.
 Loading some saves caused crashes or some issues and this has been fixed.
 The pilots are now changing their shifts again, so that they sometimes sleep or eat.


Changes

 Objects marked for mining on the overview map will now not disappear again when scanning for new ones.
 Increased the probability of research contracts having a client.
 The Power Lines now do not require a license.
 The Chassis C now requires a license.
 The planets Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune can no longer be selected.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/c
notes.notes:
Moin,

we've made a few changes.

Fixed bugs

 Fixed modules sometimes not accepting power.
 Loading some saves caused crashes and has been fixed.


Changes

 Residents no longer take breaks to eat or sleep during their working hours.


New features

 The mouse can now be inverted.
 Mouse sensitivity can be adjusted.
 Resolution should no longer be forced to 1920x1080.
 The UI can be scaled (but be careful, it sometimes goes wrong).

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/b02

we've made a few changes.

Changes

 It is now easier to connect the Laser Tower with cables.
 The news now have a sound.


Fixed bugs

 The tutorial got stuck in some places.

Moin,

Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856210/e23b824cbda8c6c45dc1758c522f570b75f52ac7.gif

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1/a
notes.notes:
Moin,

we've made a few changes.

Changes

 The explosions on asteroid or space debris impacts have been changed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856210/086d96f23e0990e928697e2f5117fc143dda1c0a.gif
 The main menu is now larger.
 Resident portraits are now made randomly when a resident is created, so they look a little more different.
 The game now saves automatically when exiting or going to the main menu.
 The loading menu shows which save games may lead to errors.


Fixes

 Fixed save and load crashes.
 Fixed crashes caused by asteroid impacts.


Notes

 Older savegames are unfortunately not compatible with this patch.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1
notes.notes:
Moin,

we made some changes to the game and also introduced some new stuff.

Changes

 The construction drones have been equipped with a laser, so building looks even nicer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856210/eb3c845ab9f6675ab0d12612e6be5191239582ef.gif
 The tutorial got flashing buttons and is now a bit easier to use.
 Explosions now appear when asteroids hit the station.
 When assigning jobs, you can now see the residents' portraits, or a "ghost" if no one is working there.
 The selection of a Station Part is now blue.


Fixes

 Fixed construction drones just stopping working.
 Fixed running processes in modules not restarting after loading a saved game.
 Fixed some anomalies in the UI.
 Fixed the shader for the heat overlay, so it is now visible again.


Notes

 Older savegames are unfortunately not compatible with this patch.
